<span class="line" data-line="6"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">t </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> (X[:, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">1</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">] </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">+</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> 0.5</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> *</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> X[:, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">2</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">] </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">+</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> 0.3</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> *</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> torch.randn(N) </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">></span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> 0</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">).double()</span></span>
<span class="line" data-line="7"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">X </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> X.double()</span></span>
<span class="line" data-line="8"></span>
<span class="line" data-line="9"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">w </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> torch.zeros(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">3</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">dtype</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">torch.float64, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">requires_grad</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">True</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">)</span></span>
<span class="line" data-line="10"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">y </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> torch.sigmoid(X </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">@</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> w)</span></span>
<span class="line" data-line="11" data-hl="true"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">nll </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> -</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(t </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">*</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> torch.log(y) </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">+</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> (</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">1</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> -</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> t) </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">*</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> torch.log(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">1</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> -</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> y)).sum()   </span><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D"># −ln p(t|x,w)</span></span>
<span class="line" data-line="12" data-hl="true"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">nll.backward()</span></span>
<span class="line" data-line="13"></span>
<span class="line" data-line="14" data-hl="true"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">manual </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> X.T </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">@</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> (y.detach() </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">-</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> t)            </span><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D"># Σ (yₙ − tₙ) xₙ</span></span>

<span class="line" data-line="16"><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">print</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">"Σ(y − t)x            :"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, manual.numpy().round(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">6</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">))</span></span>
<span class="line" data-line="17" data-hl="true"><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">print</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">"两者相等:"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, torch.allclose(w.grad, manual))</span></span>
<span class="line" data-line="18"></span>
<span class="line" data-line="19"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D"># 真实工程写法：BCEWithLogitsLoss 把 sigmoid 和 log 合在一起算，数值更稳</span></span>
<span class="line" data-line="20"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">model </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> torch.nn.Linear(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">2</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">1</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">).double()</span></span>
<span class="line" data-line="21"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">opt </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> torch.optim.SGD(model.parameters(), </span><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">lr</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">0.5</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">)</span></span>
<span class="line" data-line="22"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">loss_fn </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> torch.nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss()     </span><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D"># 默认取平均，也就是 (1/N)·(−ln p)</span></span>
<span class="line" data-line="23"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">for</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> step </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">in</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> range</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">500</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">):</span></span>
<span class="line" data-line="24"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">    opt.zero_grad()</span></span>
<span class="line" data-line="25"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">    loss </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> loss_fn(model(X[:, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">1</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">:]).squeeze(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">1</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">), t)</span></span>
<span class="line" data-line="26"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">    loss.backward()</span></span>
<span class="line" data-line="27"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">    opt.step()</span></span>
<span class="line" data-line="28"><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">print</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">"平均负对数似然:"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">round</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(loss.item(), </span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">4</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">))</span></span>
<span class="line" data-line="29"></span>
